# Avalonia – third-party license

Applies to all `Avalonia.*` packages in version 12.1.5 (MIT). The NuGet packages contain **no** license file (the nuspec names only the SPDX expression `MIT`); the text comes from the source repository.

- Source: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AvaloniaUI/Avalonia/5825bf8c66fba0c11e67c980d8ece6444576bffa/licence.md` (the commit is in the nuspec of `Avalonia` 12.1.5)
- SHA-256 of the original file: `213814d306090074d234d760239ff0f67eb9b8d20eefb4d5631bb39dbe0b769b` (the same text as at the commit of 12.1.4)
- Taken over as `LICENSE`, unchanged except for LF line endings (rule of `.gitattributes`).
